command.name: abs
command.description: The absolute value of x.

command.name: accTime
command.description: Returns the current time acceleration factor.

command.name: acos
command.description: The arccosine of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: action
command.description: Makes the unit peform an action. The format of action can be [type, target, param1, param2, param3]. Only type is required, target defaults to unit and param1, param2, param3 are type specific.

command.name: actionKeys
command.description: Returns a list of dikCodes of buttons assigned to the given user action.

command.name: actionKeysImages
command.description: Returns a list of button images or names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of maxKeys keys is listed. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes.

command.name: actionKeysNames
command.description: Returns a list of button names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of maxKeys keys is listed. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes.

command.name: activateAddons
command.description: Activates the listed addons. The list of active addons is initialized during this function.

command.name: activateKey
command.description: Activates the given key for the current user profile. The keys are used to unlock missions or campaigns. See keys, keysLimit and doneKeys in the description.ext file of the missions.

command.name: addAction
command.roper: [action, script filename(, arguments, priority, showWindow, hideOnUse, shortcut)]
command.description: Creates an action. The action ID should be returned, but due to a bug, it's not. To determine the action ID, use following algorithm: the first action added to the given vehicle has ID zero, the next vehicle has ID one, etc.

command.name: addClass
command.description: Create new subclass of file or other class.

command.name: addEventHandler
command.description: The format of handler is [type,command]. Check scripting topic Event handlers for more information. The index of the currently added handler is returned.

command.name: addLiveStats
command.description: Xbox Live MP only: adds score to the Xbox Live Statistics score for the given unit (or the commander unit of the given vehicle).

command.name: addMagazine
command.description: Adds a magazine to the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function, for example by adding 20 grenades. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: addMagazineCargo
command.description: Adds magazines to the weapon cargo space. This is used for infantry weapons. The format of magazines is [magazineName, count]. For magazineName values see CfgWeapons.

command.name: addMagazinePool
command.description: Adds count magazines of type name into the weapon pool (used in the campaign to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: addPublicVariableEventHandler
command.description: Create an event handler for given variable. The event handler will be executed when some client in MP exports a variable using publicVariable on all clients except the publishing one.

command.name: addRating
command.description: Adds number to the unit rating. This is usually used to reward for completed mission objectives. The rating for killed enemies and killed friendlies is adjusted automatically. When the rating is lower than zero, a unit is considered "renegade" and is an enemy to everyone.

command.name: addResources
command.description: Add (register) resources to the team member.

command.name: addScore
command.description: MP only: adds unit score. This is shown in the "I" MP screen as the total score.

command.name: addSwitchableUnit
command.description: Add a unit into the list of units available for team switch.

command.name: addTeamMember
command.description: Add given member to given team.

command.name: addValue
command.description: Add new value to file or class. Supported types of value are: strings, numbers and arrays (even arrays of arrays ...)

command.name: addVehicle
command.description: Tells the group it owns the vehicle now.

command.name: addWaypoint
command.description: Adds a new waypoint to a group. The waypoint is placed randomly in a circle with the given center and radius. The function returns a waypoint with format [group, index].

command.name: addWeapon
command.description: Adds the weapon to the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function, for example by adding two rifles. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: addWeaponCargo
command.description: Adds weapons to the weapon cargo space. This is used for infantry weapons. The format of weapons is [weaponName, count]. For weaponName values see CfgWeapons.

command.name: addWeaponPool
command.description: Adds count weapons of type name into the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: agent
command.description: Return a person for given agent.

command.name: agents
command.description: Return a list of agents in the current mission.

command.name: airportSide
command.description: Checks a side of the airport.

command.name: alive
command.description: Checks whether the given person, vehicle or building is't dead / destroyed.

command.name: allowDammage
command.description: Obsolete.

command.name: allowFleeing
command.description: Sets the group courage. The less courage, the sooner the group will start fleeing. 0 means maximum courage, while 1 means always fleeing.

command.name: allowGetIn
command.description: Allows the getting in of vehicles of all units in the list.

command.name: ammo
command.description: Counts how many shots the unit has left for the given magazine type.

command.name: and
command.description: a and b
command.example: alive player and alive leader player

command.name: animate
command.description: Process animation on object. Animation is defined in config file. Wanted animation phase is set to phase.

command.name: animationPhase
command.description: Return animation phase of animation on object.

command.name: animationState
command.description: Return the name of the current primary animation.

command.name: asin
command.description: The arcsine of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: assert
command.description: Tests a condition and if the condition is false, halts the program.

command.name: assignAsCargo
command.description: Assigns the soldier to the cargo / passenger space of the given vehicle.

command.name: assignAsCommander
command.description: Assigns the soldier as commander of the given vehicle.

command.name: assignAsDriver
command.description: Assigns the soldier as driver of the given vehicle.

command.name: assignAsGunner
command.description: Assigns the soldier as gunner of the given vehicle.

command.name: assignedTarget
command.description: Return the target assigned to the vehicle.

command.name: assignedVehicle
command.description: Return the vehicle person is assigned to.

command.name: assignedVehicleRole
command.description: Return the position in vehicle person is assigned to.

command.name: assignTeam
command.description: Assigns the vehicle (specifically its commander unit) to the given team. The possible team values are: "MAIN", "RED", "GREEN", "BLUE" and "YELLOW".

command.name: assignToAirport
command.description: Set airport to be used by AI on getout

command.name: atan
command.description: The arctangens of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: atan2
command.description: Returns the arctangens of x/y. The returned value is in degrees, in the range from -180 to +180, using the signs of both parameters to determine the quadrant of the returned value.

command.name: atg
command.description: The arctangens of x, the result is in degrees.

command.name: attackEnabled
command.description: Return whether leader can issue attack commands.

command.name: behaviour
command.description: Returns the behaviour mode of the given unit ("CARELESS","SAFE","AWARE","COMBAT" or "STEALTH").

command.name: benchmark
command.description: Returns the value of "3D performance" as it is in OFP preferences. This can be used to estimate computer performance. The function can be used to create missions that are able to adapt to computer peformance.

command.name: boundingBox
command.description: Returns a bounding box of given object in model coordinates space. The result is in format [[minX, minZ, minY], [maxX, maxZ, maxY]].

command.name: breakOut
command.description: Breaks block out scope named 'name'. Nil is returned.

command.name: breakTo
command.description: Breaks block to scope named 'name'. Nil is returned.

command.name: buildingPos
command.description: Returns the given indexed position in a building. The returned value is in format Position.

command.name: buttonAction
command.description: Returns the action assigned to the control with id idc of the topmost user dialog. The action is any expression in this scripting language. The function can be used for buttons and active texts.

command.name: buttonAction
command.description: Returns the action assigned to the given button or active text. The action is any expression in this scripting language.

command.name: buttonSetAction
command.description: Assigns an action to the control with id idc of the topmost user dialog. Action is any expression in this scripting language. The function can be used for buttons and active texts.

command.name: buttonSetAction
command.description: Assigns an action to the given button or active text. Action is any expression in this scripting language.

command.name: cadetMode
command.description: Returns true if the mission is played in cadet mode and false in veteran mode.

command.name: call
command.description: Executes the function body. Argument pars is passed as _this.

command.name: call
command.description: Executes the given code.

command.name: camCommand
command.description: Executes a command on the given camera / actor object. The "manual on" and "manual off" commands are recognized for all types. For the "camera" type, the following commands can be used: "inertia on" and "inertia off". For the "seagull" type it's one of: "landed" and "airborne".

command.name: camCommit
command.description: Commits the camera changes smoothly over time. A time of zero results in an immediate change.

command.name: camCommitPrepared
command.description: Commits the prepared camera changes smoothly over time. A time of zero results in an immediate change.

command.name: camCommitted
command.description: Checks whether the camera has finished committing.

command.name: camCreate
command.description: Creates a camera or an actor of the given type on the given initial position (format Position). Its type is one of "CAMERA" or "SEAGULL".

command.name: camDestroy
command.description: Destroys the camera.

command.name: cameraEffect
command.description: Switches the camera to the given vehicle / camera. The format of effect is [name, position]. Name is one of: "Internal", "External", "Fixed" or "FixedWithZoom". Position is one of: "TOP", "LEFT", "RIGHT", "FRONT" or "BACK" ("BACK" is normally used).

command.name: cameraInterest
command.description: Return camera interest for given entity.

command.name: cameraOn
command.description: Returns the vehicle to which the camera is attached.

command.name: campaignConfigFile
command.description: Return root of campaign description.ext entries hierarchy.

command.name: camPreload
command.description: Preload the scene for he prepared camera. Time gives timeout, zero means no (infinite) timeout.

command.name: camPreloaded
command.description: Checks whether the camera has finished preloading.

command.name: camPrepareBank
command.description: Prepares the camera bank angle. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareDir
command.description: Prepares the camera heading. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareDive
command.description: Prepares the camera dive angle. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareFocus
command.description: focusRange is in format [distance,blur]. Prepares the camera focus blur. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareFov
command.description: Prepares the camera field of view (zoom). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareFovRange
command.description: Prepares the camera field of view range for auto zooming. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPreparePos
command.description: Prepares the camera position (format Position). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareRelPos
command.description: Prepares the camera position relative to the current position of the currect target (see camPrepareTarget). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareTarget
command.description: Prepares the camera target to a position (format Position). See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camPrepareTarget
command.description: Prepares the camera target. See also camPreload and camCommitPrepared.

command.name: camSetBank
command.description: Sets the camera bank angle. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetDir
command.description: Sets the camera heading. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetDive
command.description: Sets the camera dive angle. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetFocus
command.description: focusRange is in format [distance,blur]. Sets the camera focus blur. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetFov
command.description: Sets the camera field of view (zoom). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetFovRange
command.description: Sets the camera field of view range for auto zooming. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetPos
command.description: Sets the camera position (format Position). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetRelPos
command.description: Sets the camera position relative to the current position of the currect target (see camSetTarget). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetTarget
command.description: Sets the camera target to a position (format Position). It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camSetTarget
command.description: Sets the camera target. It does not automatically commit changes.

command.name: camUseNVG
command.description: Set / clear using of night vision during cutscenes.

command.name: canFire
command.description: Checks whether the given vehicle is able to fire. It does not check for ammo, only for damage.

command.name: canMove
command.description: Checks whether the given vehicle is able to move. It does not test for fuel, only the damage status is checked.

command.name: canStand
command.description: Checks whether the given soldier is able to stand up.

command.name: captive
command.description: Checks whether the unit is a captive. If the unit is a vehicle, its commander is checked instead.

command.name: case
command.description: see switch

command.name: catch
command.description: processes code, when exception is thrown in try block

command.name: ceil
command.description: The ceil value of x.

command.name: cheatsEnabled
command.description: Checks whether cheats are enabled (whether the designers' version is running).

command.name: civilian
command.description: The Civilian side.

command.name: clearMagazineCargo
command.description: Removes all magazines from the vehicle cargo space.

command.name: clearMagazinePool
command.description: Removes all magazines from the weapon pool (this is used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: clearRadio
command.description: Clean up the content of radio protocol history.

command.name: clearVehicleInit
command.description: Clear vehicle init field.

command.name: clearWeaponCargo
command.description: Removes all weapons from the vehicle cargo space.

command.name: clearWeaponPool
command.description: Removes all weapons from the weapon pool (this is used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: closeDialog
command.description: Closes the topmost user dialog as if a button with id idc was pressed.

command.name: closeDisplay
command.description: Close given display.

command.name: combatMode
command.description: Returns the combat mode of the given unit ("BLUE","GREEN","YELLOW" or "RED").

command.name: commander
command.description: Returns the commander of the vehicle. If the vehicle is not a vehicle, but a person, the person is returned instead.

command.name: commandFire
command.description: Orders a unit to commence firing on the given target (via the radio). If the target is objNull, the unit is ordered to commence firing on its current target (set using doTarget or commandTarget).

command.name: commandFollow
command.description: Orders a unit to follow the given unit (via the radio).

command.name: commandFSM
command.description: Orders a unit to process command defined by FSM file (via the radio).

command.name: commandGetOut
command.description: Orders the unit to get out from the vehicle (via the radio).

command.name: commandMove
command.description: Orders the unit to move to the given position (format Position) (via the radio).

command.name: commandStop
command.description: Orders the unit to stop (via the radio). Note: the stop command is never finished; the unit will never be ready.

command.name: commandTarget
command.description: Orders the unit to target the given target (via the radio).

command.name: commandWatch
command.description: Orders the unit to watch the given position (format Position) (via the radio).

command.name: commandWatch
command.description: Orders the unit to watch the given target (via the radio).

command.name: comment
command.description: This function does nothing. It's used to create comments.

command.name: compile
command.description: Compile expression.

command.name: composeText
command.description: Creates a structured text by joining the given structured or plain texts.
command.example: txt = composeText ["First line", image "data\isniper.paa", lineBreak, "Second line"]

command.name: configFile
command.description: Return root of config entries hierarchy.

command.name: configName
command.description: Returns name of config entry.

command.name: controlNull
command.description: A non-existing control. This value is not equal to anything, including itself.

command.name: cos
command.description: The cosine of x, the argument is in degrees.

command.name: count
command.description: The number of elements in the array.

command.name: count
command.description: Returns count of subentries.

command.name: count
command.description:
Counts the elements in the array for which the given condition is true.
It is calculated as follows:
1) Set the count to 0. 2) For each element in the array assign an element as _x and evaluate the condition expression. If it's true, increase the count.

command.name: countEnemy
command.description: Counts how many units in the array are considered enemy by the given unit.

command.name: countFriendly
command.description: Counts how many units in the array are considered friendly by the given unit.

command.name: countSide
command.description: Checks how many vehicles belong to the given side.

command.name: countType
command.description: Counts how many vehicles in the array are of the given type. For types see CfgVehicles.

command.name: countUnknown
command.description: Counts how many units in the array are considered unknown to the given unit.

command.name: createAgent
command.description: Creates an (independent) agent (person) of the given type (type is a name of a subclass of CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The unit is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius. Special properties can be: "NONE" and "FORM".

command.name: createCenter
command.description: Creates a new AI center for the given side.

command.name: createCollection
command.description: Creates a collection.

command.name: createDialog
command.description: Creates a user dialog from the resource template name. If a user dialog already exists, it creates a child dialog of the topmost user dialog. The class name is searched in the description.ext file of the mission, the description.ext file of the campaign and the globlal resource.cpp file. The function returns its success.

command.name: createDisplay
command.description: Create child display of given display and load from resource "name".

command.name: createGroup
command.description: Creates a new AI group for the given center (side).

command.name: createGuardedPoint
command.description: Adds a point guarded by the given side. If idStatic is not negative, the position of a static object with the given id is guarded. If the given vehicle is valid, the starting position of the vehicle is guarded, otherwise the given position is guarded.

command.name: createInventoryItem
command.description: Create a new inventory item in a container. Returns if item was successfully created.

command.name: createJoint
command.description: Creates a joint.

command.name: createMarker
command.description: Creates a new marker on the given position. The marker name has to be unique. The marker is created on all computers in a network session.

command.name: createMarkerLocal
command.description: Creates a new marker on the given position. The marker name has to be unique. The marker is only created on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: createMine
command.description: Creates a mine of the given type (type is the name of the subclass of CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The mine is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius.

command.name: createMissionDisplay
command.description: Create single missions display as a child of given display. The mission dialog will be set to the directory given as an argument "root".

command.name: createReactor
command.description: Creates a reactors for body.

command.name: createSoundSource
command.description: Creates a sound source of the given type (type is the name of the subclass of CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The sound source is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius.

command.name: createTarget
command.description: Provide unit information about a non-existant target (targetDescription is [type,position,typeAccuracy,posAccuracy])

command.name: createTeam
command.description: Create a team and name it.

command.name: createTrigger
command.description: Creates a new trigger on the given position. An object of the given type is created; this type must be a class name in CfgNonAIVehicles or CfgVehicles with simulation=detector.

command.name: createUnit
command.description: Creates a unit of the given type. The format of unitInfo is: [pos (Position), group (Group), init (String), skill (Number), rank (String)]. Note: init, skill and rank are optional. Their default values are "", 0.5, "PRIVATE".

command.name: createUnit
command.description: Creates a unit (person) of the given type (type is a name of a subclass of CfgVehicles) and makes it a member of the given group. If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The unit is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius. Special properties can be: "NONE" and "FORM".
command.example: unit = group player createUnit ["SoldierWB", position player, [], 0, "FORM"]

command.name: createVehicle
command.description: Creates a vehicle of the given type (type is the name of the subclass in CfgVehicles). If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The vehicle is placed inside a circle with this position as center and placement as its radius. Special properties can be: "NONE", "FLY" and "FORM".

command.name: createVehicle
command.description: Creates an empty vehicle of the given type. Pos is in format Position. See CfgVehicles for possible type values.

command.name: createVehicleLocal
command.description: Creates an empty vehicle of the given type. Pos is in format Position. See CfgVehicles for possible type values. Vehicle is not transferred through network in MP games.

command.name: crew
command.description: Returns all units mounted in the given vehicle. If the vehicle is not a vehicle, but person, a list containing only persons is returned.

command.name: ctrlActivate
