command.name: leader
command.description: Returns the group leader for the given unit. For dead units, objNull is returned.

command.name: leader
command.description: Returns the group leader for the given group. For a dead unit, grpNull is returned.

command.name: leader
command.description: Return the leader of given team.

command.name: leaveVehicle
command.description: Ceases the using of the vehicle in the group. It unassigns all grouped units from the vehicle.

command.name: leaveVehicle
command.description: Ceases the using of the vehicle in the group. It unassigns all grouped units from the vehicle.

command.name: lightAttachObject
command.description: Attach light to given object (at given position).

command.name: lightDetachObject
command.description: Detach light from object.

command.name: lightIsOn
command.description: Checks whether the lampost is turned on. Possible values are "ON", "OFF" and "AUTO" (auto means the lamp will be shining during the night automatically).

command.name: limitSpeed
command.description: Limit speed of given vehicle to given value (in km/h).

command.name: lineBreak
command.description: Creates a structured text containing a line break.

command.name: list
command.description: Returns a list of units that would activate the given trigger. For a trigger of type "Not present" the list is the same as the list that would be returned for type "Present".

command.name: listConfigNames
command.description: Returns a list of all files in Users\<username>\Config.

command.name: listInventoryItems
command.description: Returns list of all inventory items in given container.

command.name: ln
command.description: The natural logarithm of x.

command.name: loadConfig
command.description: Creates a config file and loads it from the file. The filename cannot contain any path. The file is searched in Users\<username>\Config.

command.name: loadFile
command.description: Returns the content of the given file.

command.name: loadIdentity
command.description: Loads person's identity from objects.sav file in campaign directory (from entry name).

command.name: loadStatus
command.description: Loads object's properties from objects.sav file in campaign directory (from entry name).

command.name: local
command.description: MP: checks whether the given unit is local on the computer. This can be used when one or more activation fields or scripts need to be performed only on one computer. In SP all objects are local. Note: all static objects are local on all computers.

command.name: localize
command.description: Replaces the string with the given name with the corresponding localized text from the stringtable.csv file.

command.name: lock
command.description: Locks the vehicle (disables mounting / dismounting) for the player.

command.name: locked
command.description: Checks whether the vehicle is locked for the player. If it's locked, the player cannot mount / dismount without an order.

command.name: lockWp
command.description: Disables switching to the next waypoint (the current waypoint will never complete while lockWp is used). This is sometimes used during cut-scenes.

command.name: log
command.description: The base-10 logarithm of x.

command.name: lookAt
command.description: Control what the unit is looking at (target or position) (format Position)
command.example: someSoldier lookAt otherSoldier; otherSoldier lookAt getMarkerPos "markerOne"

command.name: magazines
command.description: Returns an array with the type names of all the vehicle's magazines.

command.name: mapAnimAdd
command.description: Adds the next frame to the map animation. The format of frame is [time, zoom, position], the format of position is Position2D.

command.name: mapAnimClear
command.description: Clears the map animation.

command.name: mapAnimCommit
command.description: Plays the map animation.

command.name: mapAnimDone
command.description: Checks whether the map animation has finished.

command.name: markerColor
command.description: Gets the marker color. See setMarkerColor. Note: this function is identical to getMarkerColor.

command.name: markerDir
command.description: Gets the marker direction. See setMarkerDir.

command.name: markerPos
command.description: Returns the marker positon in format [x,z,y]. Note: this function is identical to getMarkerPos.

command.name: markerSize
command.description: Gets the marker size. See setMarkerSize. Note: this function is identical to getMarkerSize.

command.name: markerText
command.description: Gets the marker text. See setMarkerText.

command.name: markerType
command.description: Gets the type of the marker. See setMarkerType. Note: this function is identical to getMarkerType.

command.name: max
command.description: The greater of a,b

command.name: members
command.description: Return a list of members in given team.

command.name: min
command.description: The smaller of a,b

command.name: missionConfigFile
command.description: Return root of mission description.ext entries hierarchy.

command.name: missionName
command.description: Returns the name of the current mission.

command.name: missionStart
command.description: Returns the time of the mission start in format [year, month, day, hour, minute, second].

command.name: mod
command.description: The remainder of a divided by b. Note that the remainer is calculated in the real domain.

command.name: modelToWorld
command.description: Converts position from object model space to world space.

command.name: move
command.description: Creates a move waypoint on the given position (format Position) and makes it the currently active group waypoint.

command.name: moveInCargo
command.description: Moves the soldier into a vehicle's specified cargo position. (Immediately, without animation).

command.name: moveInCargo
command.description: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's cargo position. (Immediately, without animation).

command.name: moveInCommander
command.description: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's commander position. (Immediatetely, without animation).

command.name: moveInDriver
command.description: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's driver position. (Immediately, without animation).

command.name: moveInGunner
command.description: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's gunner position. (Immediately, without animation).

command.name: moveInTurret
command.description: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's turret. (Immediately, without animation).

command.name: moveInventoryItem
command.description: Move inventory item to a new container. Returns if item was successfully moved.

command.name: moveTarget
command.description: Change information about a target (posDescription is [position,typeAccuracy,posAccuracy])

command.name: moveTo
command.description: Low level command to person to move to given position.

command.name: moveToCompleted
command.description: Check if latest low level moveTo command is finished.

command.name: moveToFailed
command.description: Check if latest low level moveTo command failed.

command.name: musicVolume
command.description: Checks the current music volume (set by fadeMusic).

command.name: name
command.description: Returns the name of the variable assigned to the object in the mission editor. When used on a vehicle, the name of the first crew member is returned (in order: commander, driver, gunner).

command.name: nearestBuilding
command.description: Returns the nearest building to the given object.

command.name: nearestObject
command.description: Returns the nearest object of the given type to the given position or object. Pos may be using format [x,y,z, "type"] or [object, "type"].

command.name: nearestObject
command.description: Find object nearest to given position with given Visitor id.

command.name: nearestObject
command.description: Find object nearest to given position with given type.

command.name: nearestObjects
command.description: Returns a list of nearest objects of the given types to the given position or object, within the specified distance. Pos may be using format [x,y,z, ["type",...], limit] or [object, ["type",...], limit].

command.name: nearHierarchyItems
command.description: Find items in the circle with given radius. If typeName is given, only objects of given type (or its subtype) are listed.

command.name: nearObjects
command.description: Find objects in the circle with given radius. If typeName is given, only objects of given type (or its subtype) are listed.

command.name: nearTargets
command.description: Check target database of the unit for all targets in max. distance radius around it. The output is list of items: [position, type, side, subj. cost, object]

command.name: needReload
command.description: Return how much vehicle wants to reload its weapons.

command.name: newConfig
command.description: Creates a new config file.

command.name: nextWeatherChange
command.description: Return the time (in seconds) when the next weather change will occur.

command.name: nil
command.description: Nil value. This value can be used to undefine an existing variable.

command.name: not
command.description: not a

command.name: object
command.description: Return the object represented by the item.

command.name: objNull
command.description: A non-existing object. This value is not equal to anything, including itself.

command.name: objStatus
command.description: Sets the briefing objective status. Status may be one of: "ACTIVE", "FAILED", "DONE" or "HIDDEN".

command.name: onBriefingGroup
command.description: Defines a sound (voice) that is played the first time when the Group section in the briefing is selected.

command.name: onBriefingNotes
command.description: Defines a sound (voice) that is played the first time when the Notes section in the briefing is selected.

command.name: onBriefingPlan
command.description: Defines a sound (voice) that is played the first time when the Plan section in the briefing is selected.

command.name: onBriefingTeamSwitch
command.description: Defines a sound (voice) that is played the first time when the Team switch section in the briefing is selected.

command.name: onMapSingleClick
command.description:
Defines an action performed when the user clicks on the map. Command receives:
_pos array position
_units array selected units
_shift,_alt bool key state
If the click is processed, command should return true.

command.name: onPlayerConnected
command.description: This statement is launched whenever a player is connected to a MP session. Variables _id and _name are set.

command.name: onPlayerDisconnected
command.description: This statement is launched whenever a player is disconnected from a MP session. Variables _id and _name are set.

command.name: openClass
command.description: Open subclass of file or other class.

command.name: or
command.description: a or b
command.example: not alive player or not alive leader player

command.name: orderGetIn
command.description: Forces all units in the list to get in their assigned vehicle.

command.name: overcast
command.description: Return the current overcast.

command.name: overcastForecast
command.description: Return the overcast forecast.

command.name: parseNumber
command.description: Parse string containing real number.

command.name: parseText
command.description: Creates a structured text by parsing the given XML description.

command.name: pi
command.description: pi (180 degrees converted to radians)

command.name: pickWeaponPool
command.description: Transfers weapons and magazines from the cargo space of object obj to the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: player
command.description: This is the person controlled by the player. In MP this value is different on each computer.

command.name: playerRespawnTime
command.description: Return the player remaining time to respawn.

command.name: playerSide
command.description: Returns the player's side. This is valid even when the player controlled person is dead (a difference from player side).

command.name: playersNumber
command.description: Returns the number of players playing on the given side.

command.name: playMission
command.description: The mission is launched (from the main menu). Both campaign and mission are given as their directory name. If the campaign is empty, a single mission is launched. If skipBriefing is true, the intro and briefing are skipped.

command.name: playMove
command.description: When used on a person, a smooth transition to the given move will be initiated.

command.name: playMusic
command.description: Plays music defined in the description.ext file. The format of nameAndPos is [name,position]. Position is in seconds.

command.name: playMusic
command.description: Plays music defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: playSound
command.description: Plays a sound defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: position
command.description: Returns the object position in format Position.

command.name: positionCameraToWorld
command.description: Transform position from camera coordinate space to world coordinate space.

command.name: posScreenToWorld
command.description: Convert screen coordinates in map to world coordinates.

command.name: posWorldToScreen
command.description: Convert world coordinates to screen coordinates in map.

command.name: precision
command.description: Return the precision of the given entity.

command.name: preloadCamera
command.description: Preload all textures and models around given position

command.name: preloadObject
command.description: Preload all data for given object.

command.name: preloadSound
command.description: Make sure sound can start playing without any delay once we need it.

command.name: preloadTitleObj
command.description: Object title - argument uses format ["text","type",speed] or ["name","type"]. Speed is ignored. Preload data The object can be defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: preloadTitleRsc
command.description: Resource title - argument uses format ["name","type",speed] or ["name","type"]. Speed is ignored. Preload data The resource can be defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: preprocessFile
command.description: Returns the preprocessed content of the given file. The preprocessor is C-like, it supports comments using // or /* and */ and macros defined with #define.

command.name: preprocessFileLineNumbers
command.description: Returns the preprocessed content of the given file. The preprocessor is C-like, it supports comments using // or /* and */ and macros defined with #define.

command.name: primaryWeapon
command.description: Returns the name of the vehicle's primary weapon (an empty string if there is none).

command.name: private
command.description: Introduces one or more local variables in the innermost scope.

command.name: processInitCommands
command.description: Process commands stored using setVehicleInit.

command.name: publicVariable
command.description: Broadcasts the variable value to all computers. Only type Number is supported in versions 1.33 and before. The following types are supported since 1.34: Number, Boolean, Object and Group.

command.name: putWeaponPool
command.description: Transfers weapons and magazines from the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission) into the cargo space of object obj.

command.name: queryMagazinePool
command.description: Returns the number of magazines of type name in the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: queryWeaponPool
command.description: Returns the number of weapons of type name in the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

command.name: rad
command.description: Converts x from degrees to radians.

command.name: radioVolume
command.description: Checks the current radio volume (set by setRadioVolume).

command.name: rain
command.description: Return the current rain.

command.name: random
command.description: The random real value from 0 to x. (0<=random<1)

command.name: rank
command.description: Return the rank of the given unit.

command.name: rating
command.description: Checks the unit rating. This rating is increased for killing enemies, decreased for killing friendlies and can be changed by a mission designer.

command.name: reload
command.description: Reload all weapons.

command.name: reloadEnabled
command.description: Check whether magazine is reloaded whenever emptied.

command.name: removeAction
command.description: Removes the action with the given id.

command.name: removeAllEventHandlers
command.description: Removes all event handlers of the given type which were added by addEventHandler.

command.name: removeAllWeapons
command.description: Removes all weapons from the unit.

command.name: removeEventHandler
command.description: Removes event handler added by addEventHandler. Format of handler is [type,index]. Index is returned by addEventHandler. When any handler is removed, all handler indices higher that the deleted one should be decremented.

command.name: removeMagazine
command.description: Removes the magazine from the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: removeMagazines
command.description: Removes all magazines of the given type from the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: removeSwitchableUnit
command.description: Remove a unit from the list of units available for team switch.

command.name: removeTeamMember
command.description: Remove given member from given team.

command.name: removeWeapon
command.description: Removes the weapon from the unit. Note: you may create invalid combinations by using this function. When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

command.name: requiredVersion
command.description: Checks whether the appropriate version of the application is available. If it's not, a warning message is shown and false is returned. The version format is "Major.Minor", e.g. "1.30".

command.name: resistance
command.description: The Resistance side.

command.name: resize
command.description: Changes the array size. This function can be used to add or remove elements from the array.

command.name: resources
command.description: Return a list of the resources belonging to a team.

command.name: respawnVehicle
command.description: Set vehicle as respawnable in MP games. Delay is respawn delay, default respawnDelay from description.ext is used. Count tells how many respawns is processed (default unlimited).

command.name: reveal
command.description: Reveals the unit to the group. It does not matter whether the group can know about the unit or not.

command.name: round
command.description: The round value of x.

command.name: runInitScript
command.description: Launch init.sqs script.

command.name: saveConfig
command.description: Save config file. Filename cannot contain any path. File is created in Users\<username>\Config.

command.name: saveGame
command.description: Creates an autosave game (used for Retry).

command.name: saveIdentity
command.description: Saves person's identity to objects.sav file in campaign directory as entry name.

command.name: saveStatus
command.description: Saves object's properties to objects.sav file in campaign directory as entry name.

command.name: saveVar
command.description: Saves the variable value into the global campaign space. The variable is then available to all following missions in the campaign.

command.name: say
command.description: The format of speechName is [sound, maxTitlesDistance] or [sound, maxTitlesDistance, speed]. The unit will play the given sound. If the unit is a person, it will also pefrorm the corresponding lipsync effect. If the camera is not withing the given range, the title is not shown. The sound is defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: say
command.description: The unit will play the given sound. If the unit is a person, it will also pefrorm the corresponding lipsync effect. The sound is defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: scopeName
command.description: defines name of current scope. Name is visible in debugger, and name is also used as reference in some commands. Scope name can be defined only once per scope.

command.name: score
command.description: MP: returns the unit's score.

command.name: scriptDone
command.description: Check if script is already finished

command.name: scudState
command.description: Returns the current state of the given scud launcher. The following states are recognized: 0 - No activity, 1 - Launch preparation, 2 - Launch prepared, 3 - Ignition and 4 - Launched. Note: non-integral values are used to indicate a transition between states.

command.name: secondaryWeapon
command.description: Returns the name of a vehicle's secondary weapon (an empty string if there is none).

command.name: select
command.description: Selects index element of the array. Index 0 denotes the first element, 1 the second, etc.

command.name: select
command.description: If the index is false, this selects the first element of the array. If it is true, it selects the second one.

command.name: select
command.description: Returns subentry with given index.

command.name: selectionPosition
command.description: Search for selection in the object model (first in the memory level, then in other levels). Returns position in model space.

command.name: selectLeader
command.description: Select group leader.

command.name: selectPlayer
command.description: Switch player to given unit.

command.name: selectWeapon
command.description: Selects the given weapon. For weapon values see CfgWeapons.

command.name: sendSimpleCommand
command.description: Sends a simple command to the vehicle's driver / gunner.

command.name: set
command.description: Format of element is [index, value]. Changes an element of the given array. If the element does not exist, index+1 is called to create it.

command.name: setAccTime
command.description: Sets the time acceleration coeficient. It can also be used to slow down time in cutscenes.

command.name: setAirportSide
command.description: Set owner of the airport

command.name: setAmmoCargo
command.description: Sets the amount of ammo resources in the cargo space of a repair vehicle. Ammo resources are used to resupply vehicles; soldiers use individual magazines instead. An amount of one indicates a full cargo.

command.name: setAperture
command.description: Sets custom camera apreture (-1 to do it automatically).

command.name: setAttributes
command.description: Returns a structured text created by the given structured or plain text by setting attributes to the given values.

command.name: setBehaviour
command.description: Sets the group behaviour mode. Behaviour is one of: "CARELESS", "SAFE", "AWARE", "COMBAT" or "STEALTH".

command.name: setCameraInterest
command.description: Set camera interest for given entity.

command.name: setCaptive
command.description: Marks the unit as captive. If the unit is a vehicle, the vehicle commander is marked instead. A captive is neutral to everyone. Note: This function does not remove the unit's weapons.

command.name: setCombatMode
command.description: Sets the group's combat mode (engagement rules). Mode can be one of: "BLUE" (Never fire), "GREEN" (Hold fire - defend only), "WHITE" (Hold fire, engage at will), "YELLOW" (Fire at will) or "RED" (Fire at will, engage at will).

command.name: setCombatMode
command.description: Sets the team member's combat mode (engagement rules). Mode can be one of: "BLUE" (Never fire), "GREEN" (Hold fire - defend only), "WHITE" (Hold fire, engage at will), "YELLOW" (Fire at will) or "RED" (Fire at will, engage at will).

command.name: setCurrentWaypoint
command.description: Switch the group to process the given waypoint.

command.name: setDamage
command.description: Damages / repairs the object. Damage 0 means the object is fully functional, damage 1 means it's completely destroyed / dead. Note: this function is identical to setDammage. It was introduced to fix a spelling error in the original function name.

command.name: setDammage
command.description: Damages / repairs the object. Damage 0 means the object is fully functional, damage 1 means it's completely destroyed / dead.

command.name: setDate
command.description: Sets the actual mission date and time.

command.name: setDestination
command.description: Set the destination for path planning of the pilot.

command.name: setDir
command.description: Sets the object heading. The accepted heading range is from 0 to 360.

command.name: setDropInterval
command.description: Set interval of emitting particles from particle source.

command.name: setEffectCondition
command.description: The statement is executed when the trigger or waypoint is activated and the effects are launched depending on the result. If the result is a boolean and true, the effect was launched. If the result is an object, the effect was launched if the result is the player or the player vehicle. If the result is an array, the effect was launched if the result contains the player or the player vehicle.

command.name: setFace
command.description: Sets the person's face.

command.name: setFaceanimation
command.description: Sets the facial animation phase (eye blinking). Blink is in the range from 0 to 1.

command.name: setFlagOwner
command.description: Sets the flag owner. When the owner is set to objNull, the flag is returned to the flagpole.

command.name: setFlagSide
command.description: Sets the flag side.

command.name: setFlagTexture
command.description: Sets the flag texture. If the texture is "", the flag is not drawn.

command.name: setFog
command.description: Changes the fog value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. A fog level of zero is minimum fog and a fog level of one is maximum fog.

command.name: setFormation
command.description: Sets the group formation. Formation is one of: "COLUMN", "STAG COLUMN", "WEDGE", "ECH LEFT", "ECH RIGHT", "VEE" or "LINE".

command.name: setFormation
command.description: Set a new formation to given team.

command.name: setFormationTask
command.description: Set the current task of the formation member.

command.name: setFormDir
command.description: Sets the formation heading. The accepted heading range is from 0 to 360. The formation is facing this direction unless an enemy is seen. When the group is moving, this value is overridden by the movement direction.

command.name: setFriend
command.description: Sets how friendly side1 is with side2. For a value smaller than 0.6 it results in being enemy, otherwise it's friendly.

command.name: setFromEditor
command.description: Set if given team member was inserted directly from editor.

command.name: setFuel
command.description: Sets the fuel amount. A fuel level of one is a full gas tank.

command.name: setFuelCargo
command.description: Sets the fuel amount in the cargo space of a refuelling vehicle. A fuel level of one is a full gas tank.

command.name: setGroupid
command.description: Sets the group identity. nameFormat contains strings "%CLASS_NAME" where CLASS_NAME is name of class in CfgWorlds, parameters are names of subclasses of CLASS_NAME with the description of the name subpart.

command.name: setHideBehind
command.description: It sets the data for hiding. ObjectWhereHide can be taken using findCover. HidePosition can be taken using getHideFrom.

command.name: setHit
command.description: Damage / repair part of object. Damage 0 means fully functional, damage 1 means completely destroyed / dead.

command.name: setIdentity
command.description: Sets the identity of a person. Identities are defined in the descripion.ext file of the mission or campaign.

command.name: setLeader
command.description: Set the leader of given team.

command.name: setLightAmbient
command.description: Set ambient color of light.

command.name: setLightBrightness
command.description: Set brightness of light.

command.name: setLightColor
command.description: Set diffuse color of light.

command.name: setMarkerBrush
command.description: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerBrushLocal
command.description: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerColor
command.description: Sets the marker color. Color is one of: "Default", "ColorBlack", "ColorRed", "ColorRedAlpha", "ColorGreen", "ColorGreenAlpha", "ColorBlue", "ColorYellow" or "ColorWhite". The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerColorLocal
command.description: Sets the marker color. Color is one of: "Default", "ColorBlack", "ColorRed", "ColorRedAlpha", "ColorGreen", "ColorGreenAlpha", "ColorBlue", "ColorYellow" or "ColorWhite". The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerDir
command.description: Sets the orientation of the marker. Angle is in degrees. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerDirLocal
command.description: Sets the orientation of the marker. Angle is in degrees. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerPos
command.description: Moves the marker. The format of pos is Position2D. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerPosLocal
command.description: Moves the marker. The format of pos is Position2D. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerShape
command.description: Selects the shape (type) of the marker. Shape can be "ICON", "RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE". The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerShapeLocal
command.description: Selects the shape (type) of the marker. Shape can be "ICON", "RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE". The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerSize
command.description: Sets the marker size. Size is in format [a-axis, b-axis]. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerSizeLocal
command.description: Sets the marker size. Size is in format [a-axis, b-axis]. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerText
command.description: Sets the text label of an existing marker. The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerTextLocal
command.description: Sets the text label of an existing marker. The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMarkerType
command.description: Sets the marker type. Type may be any of: "Flag", "Flag1", "Dot", "Destroy", "Start", "End", "Warning", "Join", "Pickup", "Unknown", "Marker", "Arrow" or "Empty". The marker is modified on all computers in a network session.

command.name: setMarkerTypeLocal
command.description: Sets the marker type. Type may be any of: "Flag", "Flag1", "Dot", "Destroy", "Start", "End", "Warning", "Join", "Pickup", "Unknown", "Marker", "Arrow" or "Empty". The marker is only modified on the computer where the command is called.

command.name: setMimic
command.description: Sets a unit's mimic. The following values are recognized: "Default", "Normal", "Smile", "Hurt", "Ironic", "Sad", "Cynic", "Surprised", "Agresive" and "Angry".

command.name: setMousePosition
command.description: Move (UI) mouse pointer to specified position of the screen.

command.name: setMusicEffect
command.description: Defines the music track played on activation. Track is a subclass name of CfgMusic. "$NONE$" (no change) or "$STOP$" (stops the current music track).

command.name: setOvercast
command.description: Changes the overcast level to the given value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means an immediate change. An overcast level of zero means clear (sunny) weather and with an overcast level of one, storms and showers are very likely.

command.name: setParticleCircle
command.description: Update particle source to create particles on circle with given radius. Velocity is transformed and added to total velocity.

command.name: setParticleParams
command.description: Set parameters to particle source. Array is in format ParticleArray.

command.name: setParticleRandom
command.roper: [lifeTime, position, moveVelocity, rotationVelocity, size, color, randomDirectionPeriod, randomDirectionIntensity, {angle}]
command.description: Set randomization of particle source parameters.

command.name: setPlayable
command.description: Create MP role for the unit.

command.name: setPos
command.description: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the Position format.
command.example: player setPos [getpos player select 0, getpos player select 1 + 10]

command.name: setPosASL
command.description: Sets the object position. The pos array uses the PositionASL format.
command.example: player setPosASL [getposASL player select 0, getposASL player select 1 + 10, getPosASL select 2]

command.name: setRadioMsg
command.description: Sets the radio message (0, 0, map radio) to the given text. Use "NULL" to disable the radio slot.

command.name: setRain
command.description: Changes the rain density smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means an immediate change. A rain level of zero is no rain and a rain level of one is maximum rain. Rain is not possible when overcast is smaller than 0.7.

command.name: setRank
command.description: Sets rank of given unit. Possible values: PRIVATE, CORPORAL, SERGEANT, LIEUTENANT, CAPTAIN, MAJOR or COLONEL.

command.name: setRepairCargo
command.description: Sets the amount or repair resources in the cargo space of a repair vehicle. An amount of one is a full cargo space.

command.name: setSkill
command.description: Sets ability levell of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

command.name: setSkill
command.description: Sets skill of given type of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

command.name: setSoundEffect
command.description: Defines the different sound effects. Sound / voice plays a 2D / 3D sound from CfgSounds. SoundEnv plays an enviromental sound from CfgEnvSounds. SoundDet (only for triggers) creates a dynamic sound object attached to a trigger defined in CfgSFX.

command.name: setSpeedMode
command.description: Sets the group speed mode. Mode may be one of: "LIMITED" (half speed), "NORMAL" (full speed, maintain formation) or "FULL" (do not wait for any other units in the formation).

command.name: setTargetAge
command.description: Sets how the target is known to the other centers. They behave like the target was seen age seconds ago. Possible age values are: "ACTUAL", "5 MIN", "10 MIN", "15 MIN", "30 MIN", "60 MIN", "120 MIN" or "UNKNOWN".

command.name: setTerrainGrid
command.description: Sets the desired terrain resolution (in meters). For default landscapes the supported resolutions are: 50, 25, 12.5, 6.25 and 3.125. If you select an unsupported resolution, the nearest supported resolution is used instead.

command.name: setTitleEffect
command.description: Defines the title effect. Type can be "NONE", "OBJECT", "RES" or "TEXT". For "TEXT", the effect defines a subtype: "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" or "WHITE IN". Text is shown as text itself. For "OBJECT", text defines the shown object, a subclass of CfgTitles. For "RES", text defines a resource class, a subclass of RscTitles.

command.name: setTriggerActivation
command.description: Defines the trigger activation type. The first argument - who activates trigger (side, radio, vehicle or group member): "NONE", "EAST", "WEST", "GUER", "CIV", "LOGIC", "ANY", "ALPHA", "BRAVO", "CHARLIE", "DELTA", "ECHO", "FOXTROT", "GOLF", "HOTEL", "INDIA", "JULIET", "STATIC", "VEHICLE", "GROUP", "LEADER" or "MEMBER". The second argument - when is it activated (presention or detection by the specified side): "PRESENT", "NOT PRESENT", "WEST D", "EAST D", "GUER D" or "CIV D". The third argument - whether the activation is repeating.

command.name: setTriggerArea
command.description: Defines the area controlled by the trigger. The area is rectangular or elliptic, the width is 2 * a, the height is 2 * b. It is rotated angle degrees.

command.name: setTriggerStatements
command.description: The first argument can modify the condition of when the trigger is activated. The result of the activation defined by trigger activation is in variable this. Variable thisList contains all vehicles which caused the activation. Activ and desactiv expressions are launched upon trigger activation / deactivation.

command.name: setTriggerText
command.description: Sets the text label attached to the trigger object. This is used for example as a radio slot label for radio activated triggers.

command.name: setTriggerTimeout
command.description: Defines the time between condition satisfaction and trigger activation (randomly from min to max, with an average value mid). If the last argument is true, the condition must be fullfilled all the time.

command.name: setTriggerType
command.description: Sets the type of action processed by the trigger after activation (no action, a waypoints switch or an end of mission): "NONE", "SWITCH", "END1", "END2", "END3", "END4", "END5", "END6", "LOOSE" or "WIN".

command.name: setUnitAbility
command.description: Sets skill of given unit. Skill may vary from 0.2 to 1.0.

command.name: setUnitPos
command.description: Sets the unit position rules. Mode may be one of: "DOWN", "UP" or "AUTO".

command.name: setUnitPosWeak
command.description: Equal to setUnitPos, for usage in formation FSM (to avoid collision with setUnitPos used by the mission).

command.name: setUnitRank
command.description: Sets rank of given unit. Possible values: PRIVATE, CORPORAL, SERGEANT, LIEUTENANT, CAPTAIN, MAJOR or COLONEL.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given object.

command.name: setVariable
command.description: Set variable to given value in the variable space of given team member. If public is true then the value is broadcast to all computers.

command.name: setVectorDir
command.description: Set object's direction vector. Up vector will remain unchanged.

command.name: setVectorDirAndUp
command.description: Set object's direction and up vector

command.name: setVectorUp
command.description: Set object's up vector. Direction vector will remain unchanged.

command.name: setVehicleAmmo
command.description: Sets how much ammunition (compared to a full state defined by the vehicle type) the vehicle has. The value ranges from 0 to 1.

command.name: setVehicleArmor
command.description: Sets the armor (or health for men) state of the vehicle (a value from 0 to 1).

command.name: setVehicleId
command.description: Sets id (integer value) to vehicle. By this id vehicle is referenced by triggers and waypoints.

command.name: setVehicleInit
command.description: Execute statement attached to vehicle. This statement is also propagated over network in MP games.

command.name: setVehicleLock
command.description: Set how vehicle is locked for player. Possible values: UNLOCKED, DEFAULT or LOCKED.

command.name: setVehiclePosition
command.description: Changes the object position. If the markers array contains more than one marker names, the position of a random one is used. Otherwise, the given position is used. The object is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius.

command.name: setVehicleVarName
command.description: Sets the name of the variable which contains a reference to this object. It is necessary in MP to change the variable content after a respawn.

command.name: setVelocity
command.description: Sets the velocity (speed vector) of a vehicle.

command.name: setViewDistance
command.description: Sets the rendering distance. Default is 900 meters. The accepted range is from 500 to 5000 meters.

command.name: setWaypointBehaviour
command.description: Switches the unit behaviour when the waypoint becomes active. Possible values are: "UNCHANGED", "CARELESS", "SAFE", "AWARE", "COMBAT" and "STEALTH".

command.name: setWaypointCombatMode
command.description: The group combat mode is switched when the waypoint becomes active. Possible values are: "NO CHANGE", "BLUE", "GREEN", "WHITE", "YELLOW" and "RED".

command.name: setWaypointDescription
command.description: Sets the description shown in the HUD while the waypoint is active.

command.name: setWaypointFormation
command.description: Switches the group formation when the waypoint becomes active. Possible values are: "NO CHANGE", "COLUMN", "STAG COLUMN", "WEDGE", "ECH LEFT", "ECH RIGHT", "VEE" and "LINE".

command.name: setWaypointHousePosition
command.description: For waypoints attached to a house, this defines the target house position.

command.name: setWaypointPosition
command.description: Moves the waypoint to a random position in a circle with the given center and radius.

command.name: setWaypointScript
command.description: Attaches a script to a scripted waypoint. Command consist of a script name and additional script arguments.

command.name: setWaypointSpeed
command.description: Switches the group speed mode when the waypoint becomes active. Possible values are: "UNCHANGED", "LIMITED", "NORMAL" and "FULL".

command.name: setWaypointStatements
command.description: The waypoint is done only when the condition is fulfilled. When the waypoint is done, the statement expression is executed.

command.name: setWaypointTimeout
command.description: Defines the time between condition satisfaction and waypoint finish (randomly from min to max, with an average value mid).

command.name: setWaypointType
command.description: Changes the waypoint type. Type can be: "MOVE", "DESTROY", "GETIN", "SAD", "JOIN", "LEADER", "GETOUT", "CYCLE", "LOAD", "UNLOAD", "TR UNLOAD", "HOLD", "SENTRY", "GUARD", "TALK", "SCRIPTED", "SUPPORT", "GETIN NEAREST", "AND" or "OR".

command.name: setWPPos
command.description: Sets the waypoint position. Waypoint uses format Waypoint. Position uses format Position2D.

command.name: showCinemaBorder
command.description: Forces drawing of the cinema borders. This is normally used in cutscenes to indicate the player has no control.

command.name: showCompass
command.description: Enables the compass (the default is true).

command.name: showGps
command.description: Enables the GPS receiver (the default is false).

command.name: showMap
command.description: Enables the map (the default is true).

command.name: shownCompass
command.description: Checks whether the player has the compass enabled.

command.name: shownGps
command.description: Checks whether the player has the GPS receiver enabled.

command.name: shownMap
command.description: Checks whether the player has the map enabled.

command.name: shownPad
command.description: Checks whether the player has the notebook enabled.

command.name: shownRadio
command.description: Checks whether the player has the radio transmitter enabled.

command.name: shownWarrant
command.description: Checks whether the player has the ID card enabled. (Obsolete).

command.name: shownWatch
command.description: Checks whether the player has the watch enabled.

command.name: showPad
command.description: Enables the notepad (the default is true).

command.name: showRadio
command.description: Enables the radio (the default is false).

command.name: showWarrant
command.description: Obsolete. Enables the ID card (the default is false).

command.name: showWatch
command.description: Enables the watch (the default is true).

command.name: showWaypoint
command.description: Sets the condition determining when the waypoint is shown. Possible values are: "NEVER", "EASY" and "ALWAYS".

command.name: side
command.description: Returns the side of the unit.

command.name: sideChat
command.description: Types text to the side radio channel. Note: this function only types text to the list, it does not broadcast the message. If you want the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it on all of them.

command.name: sideEnemy
command.description: The Enemy side (used for renegades).

command.name: sideFriendly
command.description: The Friendly side (used for captives).

command.name: sideLogic
command.description: The Logic side.

command.name: sideRadio
command.description: Sends the message to the side radio channel. The message is defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: sin
command.description: The sine of x, the argument is in degrees.

command.name: sizeOf
command.description: Return the size of the entity of given type.

command.name: skill
command.description: Returns the current level of ability of the person.

command.name: skill
command.description: Returns skill of given type of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

command.name: skipTime
command.description: Skips the specified time. Daytime is adjusted, a weather change is estimated and no changes to any units are done. Duration is in hours.

command.name: sleep
command.description: Suspend execution of script for given time.

command.name: sliderPosition
command.description: Returns the current thumb position of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderPosition
command.description: Returns the current thumb position of the given slider.

command.name: sliderRange
command.description: Returns the limits (as an array [min, max]) of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderRange
command.description: Returns the limits (as an array [min, max]) of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSetPosition
command.description: Sets the current thumb position of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSetPosition
command.description: Sets the current thumb position of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSetRange
command.description: Sets the limits of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSetRange
command.description: Sets the limits of the slider with id idc of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSetSpeed
command.description: Sets the speed (a click on the arrow results in a move per line. A click on the scale outside the thumb results in a move per page) of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSetSpeed
command.description: Sets the speed (a click on the arrow results in a move per line. A click on the scale outside the thumb results in a move per page) of the given slider.

command.name: sliderSpeed
command.description: Returns the speed (as an array [line, page]) of the slider with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

command.name: sliderSpeed
command.description: Returns the speed (as an array [line, page]) of the given slider.

command.name: someAmmo
command.description: Checks whether the unit has some ammo remaining.

command.name: soundVolume
command.description: Checks the current sound volume (set by setSoundVolume).

command.name: spawn
command.description: Executes a script. Argument is passed to the script as local variable _this.

command.name: speed
command.description: Returns the object speed (in km/h).

command.name: speedMode
command.description: Returns the speed mode of the group ("LIMITED", "NORMAL" or "FULL").

command.name: sqrt
command.description: The square root of x.

command.name: startSim
command.description: Starts simulation for object.

command.name: step
command.description: Optionaly can set step. If you want to count down, step must be specified, and set negative. Default value is 1.

command.name: stop
command.description: Stops an AI unit. This function is obsolete. Use disableAI to get better control over stopping a unit.

command.name: stopped
command.description: Checks whether the unit is stopped using the "stop" command.

command.name: stopSim
command.description: Stops simulation for object.

command.name: str
command.description: Converts any variable to a string.

command.name: supportInfo
command.description: Creates list of supported operators and type. Each field of array has format: "x:name" where x is 't' - type, 'n' - nullary operator, 'u' - unary operator, 'b' - binary operator. 'name' is operator's/type's name (in case operator, type of input operands is included). `mask` parameter can be empty string, or one of field. In this case, function returns empty array, if operator is not included in list. `mask` can contain wildcards, for example: *:name, t:*, t:name* or *:*.

command.name: surfaceIsWater
command.description: Returns whether water is on given position.

command.name: surfaceType
command.description: Returns what surface is on given position.

command.name: switch
command.description: Begins switch form

command.name: switchableUnits
command.description: Return a list of units accessible through team switch.

command.name: switchCamera
command.description: Switches the camera to the given vehicle / camera. Mode is one of: "INTERNAL" (1st person), "GUNNER" (optics / sights), "EXTERNAL" (3rd person) or "GROUP" (group).

command.name: switchLight
command.description: Controls the lamppost mode. Mode may be "ON", "OFF" and "AUTO". "AUTO" is default and means the lampost is only on during nighttime.

command.name: switchMove
command.description: When used on a person, the given move is started immediately (there is no transition). Use switchmove "" to switch back to the default movement if there is no transition back, otherwise the person may be stuck.

command.name: synchronizeWaypoint
command.description: Synchronizes the waypoint with other waypoints. Each waypoint is given as an array [group, index].

command.name: synchronizeWaypoint
command.description: Synchronizes the trigger with waypoints. Each waypoint is given as an array [group, index].

command.name: tan
command.description: The tangens of x, the argument is in degrees.

command.name: teamMember
command.description: Return an agent for given person.

command.name: teamMemberNull
command.description: A non-existing team member. This value is not equal to anything, including itself.

command.name: teamName
command.description: Return a name of given team.

command.name: teams
command.description: Return a list of teams in the current mission.

command.name: teamSwitch
command.description: Invoke the team switch dialog (force it even when conditions are noy met).

command.name: teamSwitchEnabled
command.description: Check if tam switch is currently enabled.

command.name: teamType
command.description: Return a type of given team.

command.name: terminate
command.description: Terminate (abort) the script

command.name: text
command.description: Creates a structured text containing the given plain text.

command.name: textLog
command.description: Dumps the argument value into the debugging output.

command.name: tg
command.description: The tangens of x, the argument is in degrees.

command.name: then
command.description: The first or second element of the array is executed depending on the result of the if condition. The result of the executed expression is returned as a result (the result may be nothing).

command.name: then
command.description: The code is executed when the if condition is met. If the code is executed, the last value calculated in the code is returned. If the code is not executed, nothing is returned.

command.name: throw
command.description: Throws an exception. The exception is processed by first catch block. See try.

command.name: time
command.description: Returns the time that elapsed since the mission started (in seconds).

command.name: titleCut
command.description: Obsolete.

command.name: titleFadeOut
command.description: Terminate the title effect and set duration of the fade out phase to the given time.

command.name: titleObj
command.description: Object title - the argument uses format ["text","type",speed] or ["name","type"]. If speed is not given, it's assumed to be one. The object can be defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: titleRsc
command.description: Resource title - the argument uses format ["name","type",speed] or ["name","type"]. If speed is not given, it's assumed to be one. Resource can be defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: titleText
command.description: Text title - the argument uses format ["text","type",speed] or ["text","type"]. If speed is not given, it's assumed to be one.

command.name: to
command.description: Continue sequence of 'for' command.

command.name: toArray
command.description: Convert the string to the array of characters.

command.name: toLower
command.description: Convert the string to lower case.

command.name: toString
command.description: Convert the array of characters to the string.

command.name: toUpper
command.description: Convert the string to upper case.

command.name: triggerAttachObject
command.description: Assigns a static object to the trigger. The activation source is changed to "STATIC".

command.name: triggerAttachVehicle
command.description: If [] is given, the trigger is detached from the assigned vehicle. If the activation source is "VEHICLE", "GROUP", "LEADER" or "MEMBER", it's changed to "NONE". If [vehicle] is given, the trigger is attached to the vehicle or its group. When the source is "GROUP", "LEADER" or "MEMBER", it's attached to the group, otherwise it's attached to the vehicle and the source is changed to "VEHICLE".

command.name: true
command.description: Always true.

command.name: try
typeName
command.description: Returns type-name of expression. Type is returned as string

command.name: typeOf
command.description: Returns the name of the type of the given object.

command.name: unassignTeam
command.description: Unassigns the vehicle (its commander unit) from his team. This is equal to vehicle assignTeam "MAIN".

command.name: unassignVehicle
command.description: The person is unassigned from the vehicle. If he is currently inside, the group leader will issue an order to disembark.

command.name: unitPos
command.description: Return the unit position rules.

command.name: unitReady
command.description: Checks whether the unit is ready. A unit is busy when it's given an order like "move", until the command is finished.

command.name: units
command.description: Returns an array with all the units in the group of the given object. For a destroyed object an empty array is returned.

command.name: units
command.description: Returns an array with all the units in the group.

command.name: VBS_addEvent
command.description: Adds text into the events section of the mpreport.txt file.

command.name: VBS_addFooter
command.description: Adds text into the footer section of the mpreport.txt file.

command.name: VBS_addHeader
command.description: Adds text into the header section of the mpreport.txt file.

command.name: VBS_injuries
command.description: Returns a list of all injuries of the given unit. Items are in format VBS_Injury.

command.name: VBS_killed
command.description: Returns a list of all deaths of the given unit. Items are in format VBS_Kill.

command.name: VBS_kills
command.description: Returns a list of all kills caused by the given unit. Items are in format VBS_Kill.

command.name: vectorDir
command.description: Return object's direction vector in world coordinates as [x, z, y].

command.name: vectorUp
command.description: Return object's up vector in world coordinates as [x, z, y].

command.name: vehicle
command.description: Returns the vehicle in which the given unit is mounted. If there is none, the unit is returned.

command.name: vehicleChat
command.description: Types text to the vehicle radio channel. Note: this function only types text to the list, it does not broadcast the message. If you want the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it on all of them.

command.name: vehicleRadio
command.description: Sends the message to the vehicle radio channel. The message is defined in the description.ext file.

command.name: vehicles
command.description: Return a list of vehicles in the current mission.

command.name: vehicles
command.description: Return a list of vehicles in the current mission.

command.name: vehicleVarName
command.description: Returns the name of the variable which contains a reference to this object.

command.name: velocity
command.description: Returns the velocity (speed vector) of the vehicle as an array with format [x, z, y].

command.name: verifySignature
command.description: Check if file is signed by an accepted key.

command.name: vonSay
command.description: Force person to beep using VoN system.

command.name: waitUntil
command.description: Suspend execution of script until condition is satisfied.

command.name: waypointAttachObject
command.description: Attaches a static object to the given waypoint.

command.name: waypointAttachVehicle
command.description: Attaches a vehicle to the given waypoint.

command.name: waypointPosition
command.description: Gets the waypoint position. Waypoint uses format Waypoint. Note: this function is identical to getWaypointPosition.

command.name: waypoints
command.description: Return the list of waypoints for given group.

command.name: weaponDirection
command.description: Returns direction where is given weapon aiming.

command.name: weapons
command.description: Returns an array of names of all the vehicle's weapons.

command.name: weight
command.description: Return the weight of the item and all subitems.

command.name: west
command.description: The West side.

command.name: while
command.description: The first part of the while contruct.

command.name: wind
command.description: Return the current wind vector.

command.name: worldName
command.description: Return the name of the currently loaded world.

command.name: worldToModel
command.description: Converts position from world space to object model space.

type.name: Array
type.description: An array of items, each may be of any type.

type.name: If Type
type.description: A helper type used in if..then constructs.

type.name: While Type
type.description: A helper type used in while..do constructs.

array.name: ParticleArray
array.format: [ShapeName, AnimationName, Type, TimerPeriod, LifeTime, Position, MoveVelocity, RotationVelocity, Weight, Volume, Rubbing, Size, Color, AnimationPhase, RandomDirectionPeriod, RandomDirectionIntensity, OnTimer, BeforeDestroy, Object, {angle}]
array.description: Global parameters: ShapeName - Name of the shape associated with the particle. AnimationName - Name of the animation of the shape. Type - Type of the particle (either "Billboard" or "SpaceObject"). TimerPeriod - The period of calling the "OnTimer" event (in sec). LifeTime - Life time of the particle (in sec). Physical parameters: Position - Either 3D coordinate (xzy) or name of the selection - in this case the Object property must be set. MoveVelocity - 3D vector (xyz) which describes the velocity vector of the particle (direction and speed in m/s). RotationVelocity - Float number which determines number of rotations in one second. Weight - Weight of the particle (in kg). Volume - Volume of the particle (in m^3). Rubbing - Float number without dimension which determines the impact of the density od the enviroment on this particle. 0 - no impact (vacuum). Render parameters: Note that all these values are set as arrays to show their development in time. F.I. if you set the array [1,2] as a size then at the beginning the size of the particle will be 1 and at the end of the life time of the particle it's size will be 2. The rest od the values during the life time will be lineary interpolated. Size - Size of the particle in time to render (m). Color - Color of the particle in time to render (RGBA). AnimationPhase - Phase of the animation in time. Random parameters: RandomDirectionPeriod - Period of changing the velocity vector (s). RandomDirectionIntensity - Each MoveVelocity component will be changed with random value from interval <0, RandomDirectionIntensity>. OnTimer - Name of the script to run every period determined by TimerPeriod property. Position of the particle is stored in "this" variable. BeforeDestroy - Name of the script to run right before destroying the particle. Position of the particle is stored in "this" variable. Object - Object to bind this particle to.
